result.reason: The added operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at Commerce One’s then-current rates, data return within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and subsequent deletion with written certification. The amendment is limited to the required exit obligations and leaves the existing survival and support provisions intact. Drafting is professional, though using a defined term such as “Customer Data” and specifying the precise deletion deadline would improve consistency and eliminate minor ambiguity in “thereafter.”
